# Loop through questions

#### Course: Game Logic with JavaScript

## Loop through questions

We use a while loop to run the same steps for each question. Without arrays yet we use a fixed number of questions (e.g. 5) and a counter. Each time through the loop we ask for an answer, validate it, and update the score.

- start counter at 0
- while counter is less than total questions
- do one question
- add 1 to the counter

```javascript
1var score = 0;
2var i = 0;
3var total = 5;
4var correctAnswer = "A";
5
6while (i < total) {
7  var num = i + 1;
8
9  console.log("Q" + num + ". Enter A, B, or C:");
10  var userAnswer = prompt("Your answer: ");
11
12  if (userAnswer) {
13    userAnswer = userAnswer.trim().toUpperCase();
14  }
15
16  if (userAnswer === correctAnswer) {
17    score++;
18  }
19  i++;
20}
21
22console.log("Score: " + score + "/" + total);
```

Here we loop 5 times. Each time we show a question number, prompt for an answer, normalize it, and if it matches the correct answer we add 1 to score.
